Subject: Action Required: Invoice RT-8023 on Hold

Dear Accounts Receivable Team,

With reference to PO-2026-1023, invoice RT-8023 dated October 8, 2026, totaling -USD 240.00, has been placed on hold.

Our review identified the following issues:

- The invoice total is negative, which suggests that it may be a credit note rather than an invoice requiring payment.
- Item CTN-500 shows a negative quantity or price. This may indicate a credit transaction or a data entry error and requires verification.

Please confirm whether invoice RT-8023 is intended to be a credit note or whether the negative quantity and total are errors.

If it is a credit transaction, please issue a credit note. Otherwise, please provide a corrected invoice with the accurate quantity, pricing, and total.

Kind regards,
